custom_variables.emailBody:
Hey Koushik,

Just read your piece 10 Interactive Demo Examples for Customer Onboarding. The intro says onboarding content is "either too slow (a call) or too passive (a doc, a video)".

We're both in the video space, so a founder quote swap could work well for both of us: one from me for your intro, and one from you for ours.

In return, a credit link back to motiontheagency.com with my quote, and one to you with your quote on ours, or we'll pay for placement instead.

Would you be open to exploring this?

Cheers,
Sam
